warnings: Steel roof trusses T1, T2 (แบบขยายโครงหลังคาเหล็กรูปพรรณ 1/50). Cold-formed lipped channels: chords and posts C-100x50x20x2.3mm (steel_section), webs C-75x45x15x2.3mm (member_sections).

The purlin callout 'แปเหล็กสำเร็จรูป-เหล็กอาบสังกะสี C-75x35x8.5x0.75มม.' is hand-corrected over a struck-through printed size on both trusses; the S-24 notes print 'C-75x35x8.5x0.75mm@ 1.00m.' (agrees).
Truss positions on the roof plan: S-07 view1 (_view1_roof_frame_plan.json).
